cover_about: The cover tree is not pinned: placement reshuffles the forest on every rebuild. At setup the encounter takes the redwood nearest cover_anchor_xy_m (the tree it stood behind on 2026-11-20) whose approach, the tree plus approach_offset_m (the offset every re-pick has kept), is dry, inside the tutor's Tumble Hill radius, no steeper than 0.8 m over 2.8 m toward the tree and clear for the route; otherwise the next nearest (client/web/src3d/organoid-encounter.js pickCoverTree).

tips.text: Run down the fall line and hold Shift (LB) to tuck and roll. Let go on the flat to find your feet.
That’s the gondola! Press G (RB) to board the next cabin. Riding, T (RB) is fast travel and V (Y) changes the view.
Draw your katana with F (Y) and slash with Q (B). The bells, targets and scarecrows answer back!

dialogue.speaker: Organoid
dialogue.text: Voices climb the ridge. I needed one that wouldn’t.

dialogue.speaker: Ronin
dialogue.text: [A rising trill and a short chirp.]

dialogue.speaker: Organoid
dialogue.text: The old beacons. One has been calling this valley by a name it had before the sky burned.

dialogue.speaker: Organoid
dialogue.text: Until a bearing goes. Beyond the rim, the Salt Steps trade copper and bearings for seeds and sailcloth. Take what we can grow.

dialogue.speaker: Organoid
dialogue.text: Keep flying. It learned mine before I was born.

dialogue.speaker: Organoid
dialogue.text: You understand. The village is counting on us.
